usedFor: ikas holds your store orders, and Google Docs keeps a running record through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in ikas, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new order is written into a Google Docs tab, giving you a readable order log.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add, not replace, for a running log.
